title: Full-Stack Web Development Certification Quiz
description: Demonstrate your understanding of React state mechanics, Express middleware, and JWT security to earn your badge.

questions.questionText: Which React hook is primarily used for managing local state inside a functional component?
questions.explanation: useState declares a state variable that preserves values across re-renders.

questions.questionText: In Express.js, middleware functions have access to the request object (req), response object (res), and the next middleware function (next).
questions.explanation: True! Middleware functions can execute code, make changes to req/res, and call next() to pass control.

questions.questionText: What HTTP status code is universally used to indicate a successful resource creation?
questions.explanation: HTTP 201 Created signifies that the request succeeded and resulted in the creation of a new resource.

questions.questionText: JSON Web Tokens (JWT) consist of three parts separated by dots: header, payload, and ________.
questions.explanation: A JWT consists of Header.Payload.Signature encoded in Base64Url.

questions.questionText: Bcrypt uses salt rounds to protect stored passwords against rainbow table attacks and brute force cracking.
questions.explanation: Bcrypt automatically generates a unique random cryptographic salt for each password hash.

title: UI/UX Design Systems Mastery Quiz
description: Verify your design system architecture and Figma Auto Layout competency.

questions.questionText: In Figma, what feature dynamically adjusts component padding and direction when child layers change?
questions.explanation: Auto Layout allows buttons, lists, and cards to dynamically stretch and wrap based on their content.

questions.questionText: WCAG AAA requires a minimum color contrast ratio of 7:1 for normal body text.
questions.explanation: True! WCAG 2.1 AAA level requires 7:1 contrast for normal text and 4.5:1 for large text.
